_about: When to remind the player to run Anki's Optimize All Presets, and what the reminder says. Both clients compute it from the collection and the reminder's state; the server only keeps the state. Times are epoch milliseconds, so the state means the same on every device: collections on different devices can number their days differently, so the state never holds a collection day. Inputs: `now_ms` is the time now; `last_optimized_ms` is when Optimize All Presets last ran, by the `optimized_at` cases, or null when it never ran; `reviews_since` is the count from the `reviews` cases; `presets` holds the scheduler of every preset, by the `schedulers` cases; `state` is the reminder's state: the synced setting `optimize_reminder` (tests/fixtures/synced_settings.json), one for all the player's devices, in these objects. `optimized_at`: Anki records the last optimization only as a day: the collection config key `lastFsrsOptimize`, the collection day number Optimize All Presets last ran (Anki 24.11 and later, and the Android backend; only Optimize All Presets sets it, not Optimize Current Preset), with 0 or a missing key read as null (never). Its time is the end of that day, (day_cutoff - (today - last_optimized_day) * 86400) * 1000, where `today` is Anki's sched.today and `day_cutoff` its sched.day_cutoff in seconds, the end of today; so no answer before the optimization counts as one after it. `schedulers`: a preset's scheduler from the collection config key `fsrs` and the preset's legacy deck config keys `rwkvReviewEnabled` and `rwkvReviewInstantOrderEnabled` (missing means false): with FSRS off every preset is `sm2`, since Optimize All Presets needs FSRS; else `rwkv_instant` when rwkvReviewInstantOrderEnabled, else `rwkv_curve` when rwkvReviewEnabled, else `fsrs`. `reviews`: answers (ease > 0, type 0 to 3: learning, review, relearning, filtered; manual 4 and rescheduled 5 are not answers) whose revlog id is at least last_optimized_ms; every answer when it never ran. Each client counts them in its own revlog. `cases`: the verdict, from the first rule that holds: `off` when the state is off; `no_fsrs` when no preset is fsrs, rwkv_curve or rwkv_instant; `snoozed` while now_ms < until_ms; `dismissed` until Optimize All Presets runs again: while last_optimized_ms is null, or the state's optimized_ms is not null and last_optimized_ms < optimized_ms + 86400000 (a run counts only from a day later, since devices in other time zones put the end of the same collection day hours apart); `too_soon` when it ran and now_ms - last_optimized_ms < limits.days days; `too_few_reviews` when reviews_since < limits.reviews; else `remind`. A dismissal ends once Optimize All Presets runs again; a snooze ends at until_ms. A day is 86400000 ms. A reminder says `since` (`stale`, or `never` when it never ran) and `scheduler`: `fsrs` when every non-sm2 preset is fsrs, `rwkv` when none is, `mixed` otherwise. `transitions`: what each action does to the state. snooze sets until_ms to now_ms + limits.snooze_days days; dismiss records last_optimized_ms as optimized_ms; turn_off and turn_on are the settings switch. While off, snooze and dismiss change nothing; turn_on from any state other than off changes nothing. `wording`: the English text, in display order: title, the `since` line, the `scheduler` line, `where`, then the buttons open (opens deck options for the current deck), snooze and dismiss; `setting` and `setting_summary` are the switch. Each client translates it. The rule is crates/rules (src/optimize.rs), tested against these cases by crates/rules/tests/optimize_reminder.rs. Until the clients use its bindings, the desktop add-on (addon/optimize_reminder.py) and the Android app (AnkiquestOptimizeReminder.kt) keep copies tested against these cases.

wording.title: Time to optimize your presets
wording.stale: You last ran Optimize All Presets at least 30 days and 1,000 reviews ago.
wording.never: You have at least 1,000 reviews and haven't run Optimize All Presets yet.
wording.fsrs: It fits each preset's FSRS parameters to your review history.
wording.rwkv: Your presets use RWKV-Curve or RWKV-Instant: it fits only their FSRS fallback. RWKV itself isn't trained by it.
wording.mixed: It fits the parameters of your FSRS presets to your review history. For RWKV-Curve and RWKV-Instant presets it fits only the FSRS fallback; RWKV itself isn't trained by it.
wording.where: Optimize All Presets is in the FSRS section of deck options.
wording.setting_summary: When Optimize All Presets last ran at least 30 days and 1,000 reviews ago
